name: EMC Gold Corporation
summary: EMC Gold Corporation functions as a mineral exploration firm. Its principal venture is the Salave gold project, located in Asturias, Spain, where it holds complete ownership. This significant asset comprises five mining concessions, along with associated extensions spanning 662 hectares, and is further supplemented by an investigation permit covering an additional 2,655 hectares. The company, initially incorporated in 2007, has its head office situated in West Perth, Australia. It adopted the name EMC Gold Corporation in December 2025, having previously traded as Black Dragon Gold Corp.
